acceptance: A red test feeds the real fixture output shape (nested --- FAIL inside a package that ends ok) and gets no failure.
A real failing package is still a red.
100% coverage on changed functions; guard bundle green.

fix: Read failures from the test result of the package (the go test outcome), not from every printed --- FAIL line, so a nested RunTests fixture inside a passing package is not a red.
summary: phases/ship/repocontract.go counts the nested fixture TestInnerRunCycleErrorF4 (routingtest/engine_backfill_f4_test.go) as a real failure. It caused false reds in cycles 2041 and 2045 and appears in 23 run folders (cycles 1893 to 2045).
title: The repo-contract failure reader ignores the printed --- FAIL of a nested testing fixture in a passing package
